name: Workspace File Operations
description: Read, write, create, and delete files within the opened workspace with path traversal guards.
installGuidance: Enabled by default. No install required. Restricts operations to the workspace root unless you explicitly approve an outside path.

name: AI Diff Review
description: Shows AI-proposed edits as reviewable diffs. Accept or reject before any file is overwritten.
installGuidance: Always on for AI edits. No configuration required.

name: Integrated Terminal
description: Local shell panel. AI-initiated commands require explicit user approval before execution.
installGuidance: Uses the system shell. Approve AI command cards before they run.

name: Workspace Search
description: Keyword search across open workspace files with line previews.
installGuidance: No install required. Search is limited to the current workspace.

name: LM Studio Provider
description: OpenAI-compatible local model provider. Default base URL http://localhost:1234/v1.
installGuidance: Install LM Studio separately, load a model, and start the local server. Configure base URL in Settings.

name: Explicit Context Picker
description: Only user-selected files are sent as model context. Nothing is attached silently.
installGuidance: Select files in the AI panel before prompting.

name: Infinite Canvas (Experimental)
description: Spatial file map with focus lens and satellite cards for large workspaces.
installGuidance: Enable in the Tools catalog to show the Canvas view. Experimental polish layer.

name: Ambient Intent Radial
description: Quick intent menu for common AI actions near the caret.
installGuidance: Enable in catalog; press Ctrl+Shift+Space in the editor for the intent radial.

name: Dynamic Syntax Dimming
description: Dims inactive scopes to emphasize the active editing region.
installGuidance: Toggle in catalog. Applies a focus CSS class to the editor pane.

name: TypeScript / JavaScript
description: Monaco syntax highlighting and language detection for TS/JS/TSX/JSX.
installGuidance: Bundled with Monaco. No extra install.

name: Python
description: Monaco syntax highlighting for Python source files.
installGuidance: Bundled with Monaco. No extra install.

name: Git Status Badge
description: Shows dirty workspace hint when .git is present. Does not run network git operations.
installGuidance: Reads local .git presence only. No remotes contacted.

name: MCP Tool Dock
description: Browse the MCP catalog and connect local stdio MCP servers (command + args). Available for local LM Studio and remote models alike. Lists tools; does not invent remote credentials.
installGuidance: Enable this item, open the MCP chip in the tool dock (works in local or remote mode), then Add server or use a suggested preset. Refresh tools to probe over stdio. Dangerous shell actions still require Command Card approval.

name: Local stdio MCP client
description: Built-in client that spawns user-configured local MCP servers and calls initialize + tools/list. Works with every selected model.
installGuidance: No separate install. Configure servers in the MCP dock. Tool invocation beyond listing is not executed automatically.

name: Official MCP servers (modelcontextprotocol/servers)
description: Reference catalog for official reference servers: Filesystem, Git, Fetch, Memory, Sequential Thinking, Time. Some older GitHub/Brave/Postgres spins moved to servers-archived.
installGuidance: Browse the repo for server READMEs. Prefer current packages under @modelcontextprotocol/* or uvx mcp-server-*. Archived spins (GitHub/Brave/Postgres, etc.) live in modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived — do not assume they are maintained. ForgeLocal does not auto-install these; use MCP dock presets or Add server after you review the command.

name: Official MCP servers-archived
description: Archive of older official/community spins (e.g. GitHub, Brave Search, Postgres). Listed for honesty — treat as unmaintained unless you verify.
installGuidance: Reference only. Check each server’s README before adding a stdio command. ForgeLocal will not auto-spawn archived servers.

name: VoltAgent official MCP servers index
description: Curated index of 300+ official/vendor MCP servers. Discovery aid — not installed into ForgeLocal.
installGuidance: Open the GitHub index in a browser, pick a server, then add its stdio command in the MCP dock after you trust it. No silent install.

name: awesome-mcp-servers (punkpeye)
description: Community awesome-list of MCP servers. Use as a discovery index only.
installGuidance: Browse the list, verify the upstream package, then configure stdio yourself in the MCP dock.

name: awesome-mcp-servers (appcypher)
description: Alternate community awesome-list of MCP servers and clients.
installGuidance: Discovery only. ForgeLocal does not fetch or install entries from this list.

name: OpenHands extensions (MCP)
description: OpenHands extension catalog including MCP-oriented configs. Useful for OpenHands-style mcpServers JSON patterns.
installGuidance: OpenHands uses a standard mcpServers JSON map (command + args). Mirror that shape when adding servers in ForgeLocal’s MCP dock. Example snippet is shown below.

name: Official MCP Registry
description: Searchable registry at registry.modelcontextprotocol.io. Optional browser discovery — ForgeLocal does not auto-sync it.
installGuidance: Browse in a web browser when online. Copy a trusted server’s local stdio command into the MCP dock. No automatic registry refresh in this build.

name: Smithery MCP registry
description: Web registry at smithery.ai for discovering MCP servers.
installGuidance: User-triggered browser discovery only. Review install instructions on Smithery, then add stdio locally if appropriate.

name: PulseMCP registry
description: Web registry at pulsemcp.com for MCP server discovery.
installGuidance: Browse when online. ForgeLocal will not pull PulseMCP listings automatically.

name: Cline MCP Marketplace
description: Cline’s MCP marketplace. Configs use standard MCP JSON (command/args) compatible with other clients.
installGuidance: Marketplace configs are standard MCP JSON. Translate command + args into ForgeLocal’s MCP dock Add server form. Do not paste secrets into chat logs.

name: Filesystem MCP (starter)
description: Official filesystem MCP via npx. Restricts tools to paths you pass — set an absolute workspace path.
installGuidance: First npx may need network; then stdio is local. Replace /ABS/WORKSPACE with your project root. Confirm before adding — ForgeLocal does not auto-spawn.

mcpSuggested.name: Filesystem
mcpSuggested.note: Replace /ABS/WORKSPACE with a real absolute path before probing.

name: Git MCP (starter)
description: Official-style git MCP via uvx mcp-server-git. Point --repository at a local git checkout.
installGuidance: Requires uv/uvx. Replace /ABS/REPO with a local repository path. Review tools before use; destructive git ops should stay behind human approval.

mcpSuggested.name: Git
mcpSuggested.note: Replace /ABS/REPO with your local git root.

name: Fetch MCP (starter)
description: HTTP fetch MCP via uvx mcp-server-fetch. Can reach the network when tools are invoked — use deliberately.
installGuidance: Requires uv/uvx. Runtime may perform outbound HTTP when a model/tool calls fetch. ForgeLocal only probes tools/list unless you invoke tools yourself.

mcpSuggested.name: Fetch
mcpSuggested.note: Network-capable when tools are invoked — review carefully.

name: Context7 MCP (starter)
description: Upstash Context7 MCP for library/docs context. Suggested command uses npx.
installGuidance: Suggested: npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp. First run may download packages. Check upstream docs for any API keys — ForgeLocal will not invent them.

mcpSuggested.name: Context7
mcpSuggested.note: May require network on first npx; add any required env vars yourself.

name: Playwright MCP (starter)
description: Microsoft Playwright MCP for browser automation via npx @playwright/mcp.
installGuidance: Suggested: npx -y @playwright/mcp. May install browser binaries on first use. Confirm before adding; automation can be powerful.

mcpSuggested.name: Playwright
mcpSuggested.note: First run may download Playwright browsers.

name: Repomix MCP (starter)
description: Repomix MCP mode for packing repository context. Requires the repomix CLI on PATH.
installGuidance: Install repomix (e.g. npm i -g repomix), then use command=repomix args=--mcp. Not installed by ForgeLocal.

name: Memory MCP (starter)
description: Official memory/knowledge-graph style MCP via npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory.
installGuidance: Suggested: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory. Local stdio after package fetch.

name: Sequential Thinking MCP (starter)
description: Official sequential-thinking MCP for structured reasoning steps.
installGuidance: Suggested: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking.

name: Time MCP (starter)
description: Time/timezone MCP via uvx mcp-server-time.
installGuidance: Requires uv/uvx. Suggested: uvx mcp-server-time.

name: LocalForge Companion bridge
description: Opt-in bridge to a LocalForge Companion service (health, pairing code, workspaces). Also surfaces Companion-inspired provider discovery, hardware inventory, and git snapshot in the Companion panel. Does not replace ForgeLocal's local filesystem.
installGuidance: Install LocalForge Companion 0.3.2 on this machine if you want pairing. Open Companion on the dock → Save URL (default http://127.0.0.1:7337) → paste pairing code. Attribution: NOTICE.

name: Local provider discovery
description: Probe common local inference ports (Ollama 11434, LM Studio 1234, llama.cpp 8080/1337, Lemonade 8000) and apply a reachable endpoint as the ForgeLocal provider.
installGuidance: Companion panel → Discover local endpoints → Use as provider. Inspired by LocalForge Companion providers.js (MIT).

name: Workspace preview
description: Loopback-only static preview server for a folder inside the open project (Companion-style path jail). No LAN bind.
installGuidance: Dock → Preview → set relative dir (., dist, public) → Start. Opens an iframe on 127.0.0.1.

name: Multi-agent teaming
description: LocalAGI-inspired cooperative roles (Planner → Implementer → Reviewer). Opt in from the Agents panel; Generate Team asks your model for a custom roster. Runs sequentially on your configured LM Studio / remote model — no cloud agent pool.
installGuidance: Tools catalog → keep Multi-agent teaming enabled. Open Agents on the dock, toggle Multi-agent mode, optionally Generate Team from a goal, then Send in chat. Attribution: LocalAGI (MIT) — see NOTICE.

name: Remote Cloud Models
description: Opt-in OpenAI-compatible remote endpoint (base URL + API key) via Settings. Never used as a silent fallback from local mode.
installGuidance: Settings → Provider mode → Remote. Enter base URL and API key (stored locally, never logged). Select a discovered model to chat. MCP dock remains available in local mode independently of this.

name: Online tools & extensions
description: Allow enabling online/cloud catalog tools that need network marketplaces. Still gated to remote cloud model mode. MCP local stdio is separate and works offline with LM Studio.
installGuidance: Switch to Remote provider mode, select a model, then Enable. Disabled automatically when you return to local LM Studio. This does not gate the MCP dock.
